title: Location names in the menu and column match the location switcher
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop works at two locations, and you compare the location names on A/R Detail with the location switcher.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with every bucket expanded (Expand all).
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the location switcher in the top right of ShopView and read the two location names.
  2. Close the switcher without switching.
  3. Click the Location chip and read the two names.
  4. Read the Location column.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the switcher names {Location-A} and {Location-B}.
  • Step 2: you are still at {Location-A}.
  • Step 3: the menu names them exactly as the switcher does, letter for letter.
  • Step 4: the Location column uses the same names.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R4: “Each location is named exactly as the location switcher in the top right of ShopView names it, and the Location column uses the same name.”
